marcadores.explicacao_original: Diffuse lymphoid tissue consists of a loose network of lymphocytes located in the lamina propria throughout the gastrointestinal, respiratory and genitourinary tracts. In this location, it encounters and reacts to antigens passing through the mucosal epithelium, producing an immune response.
